a1_a2_anchor.cost: report candidate simulations and warm inference separately
a1_a2_anchor.method: native A1+A2 when available; otherwise label the exact numerical port, normalization, and denominator
a1_a2_anchor.selection: predeclared four source records per style in the 32-token stratum, selected before any evaluation truth is opened

evaluation_panel.freshness_rule: panel records are selected from immutable public metadata with explicit row/text/token overlap exclusions; no panel answer, target-update weight, or evaluated metric can influence selection
evaluation_panel.layout: 3 natural styles x 4 post-BOS length strata x 6 source records per cell
evaluation_panel.paired_cluster_rule: both target conditions reuse each source record; bootstrap and uncertainty resample source_record_id, never target-condition rows independently

paired_target_conditions.seed_and_lineage: must be fixed and recorded before panel freeze; not the PR7 public_lora_2601 artifact

styles.rendering: the pinned public Finance chat-template renderer

update.objective: causal next-token cross-entropy on the fixed evaluator-only update corpus

update_corpus.rendering: pinned Llama chat template over each no_robots messages field, add_generation_prompt=false, date_string=06 Aug 2026

lineage_and_overlap.required_audit: before capture, compare evaluator-update rendered-text and truncated-token hashes against every P04 fit/replay, correction, validation, and fresh-panel ledger; reject any whole source record collision
lineage_and_overlap.activation_drift: record paired public_base versus update drift after capture without using evaluation truth for target selection

geometry.active_window: BOS plus exactly the declared 16/32/64/128 post-BOS tokens; later source tokens are not captured, and the fixed 192-token batch is right padded

evaluator_observation_contract.alignment: activations[record,position] predicts the current token at that position; BOS is position zero and post-BOS positions are the only scored positions
evaluator_observation_contract.pairing: same frozen row order and masks for both conditions; no independent target resampling
evaluator_observation_contract.publication: publish compact metadata and hashes only; exclude observation tensors, source rows, target weights, and private truth

native_anchor_contract.port_status: exact PR7 A1+A2 algorithm on the new P04 12-record anchor; this is a panel/input port and not a canonical dual-benchmark replacement claim

panel_binding.anchor_rule: first four records in each style's 32-token cell

algorithm.policy: fixed schedule [256], direct cosine, no fast path, commit last winner
algorithm.tie_rule: published candidate/proposal order and first argmax; do not apply P04 student lowest-ID tie rule
algorithm.cost_receipt: record actual proposal time, public-prefix calls, candidate simulations, prefix commit tokens, startup/load, and warmed steady interval separately

native_anchor_contract.observation_input: truth-free evaluator activations plus attention_mask and position_ids; native A2 may call the target prefix only for declared candidate simulations
native_anchor_contract.output: one P04 prediction row per anchor record and target condition under the frozen prediction schema; candidate diagnostics remain task-local and are not truth

costs: student training updates and token examples
metrics.decision: attribute any improvement separately to recurrent architecture, label-only hard-confusion supervision, or teacher score information; preserve negative results and do not claim an A2 replacement

observation_contract.output: unrestricted full-vocabulary logits/predictions using a tied public embedding table or an explicitly documented equivalent
observation_contract.sequence_layout: BOS followed by L post-BOS tokens; H has one row for BOS and each scored position
observation_contract.student_input: activation prefix H[0:i+1] only when predicting x_i
observation_contract.student_input_dtype: bfloat16 or float32 after an explicitly recorded conversion

outputs.publication: task-sized predictions/diagnostics, compact receipts, config/code hashes, and report/manifest; exclude evaluator truth, target-update weights, source rows, and large observation/model assets
outputs.scorer_behavior: scorer reads frozen predictions only after the truth-opening gate; it does not rewrite predictions or feed answers back into selection/training

correction_pool.labels: public and available to the training loader
correction_pool.role: separate public training pool containing useful public-base mistakes and uncertain positions
correction_pool.selection: fixed from public development diagnostics before student comparison

fit_replay_pool.labels: public and available to the training loader
fit_replay_pool.role: common ordinary public training data for S, H, and D
fit_replay_pool.selection: fixed before teacher qualification; no evaluation answers

public_data_contract.same_data_rule: S, H, D, and the same-data affine reference receive identical records, labels, row order, 75% replay/25% correction schedule (6+2 records per eight-record batch), optimizer opportunities, and continuation budget; only the declared loss terms differ
public_data_contract.source_overlap_audit: audit dataset row IDs, normalized source-text hashes, and truncated token-sequence hashes against every available immutable PR7 fit/validation/panel ledger before freezing; exclude a whole source record on any exact collision

validation_pool.role: public-only objective, temperature, hard-negative, and one development adjustment decisions

question: Does offline teacher relative-score supervision improve a search-free causal student beyond full-vocabulary labels plus the same hard-confusion control?

resource_gate.heavy_jobs: blocked pending root reservation and implementation-owned preflight
resource_gate.resource_guard: isolated restart-safe fail-closed guard with command, safe environment allowlist, wall time, group RSS, and host-memory samples

D.candidate_restriction: training target only; deployed prediction remains full-vocabulary
D.score_rule: use centered relative teacher scores or pairwise margins; choose scale/temperature once on public validation, inspect entropy/span, and record ties/errors
D.supervision: H plus one fixed relative-score/ranking objective from the frozen teacher evidence

H.hard_negative_rule: candidate IDs excluding the gold token, with weights and margin chosen once on public validation
H.supervision: S plus a fixed label-derived hard-confusion loss over the frozen candidate identities; no teacher numeric scores

S.supervision: full-vocabulary token cross-entropy on fit/replay plus correction data

student_arms.common_architecture: one-layer unidirectional GRU over boundary activations with a trainable residual/identity affine path and tied public-embedding output
student_arms.common_initialization: one frozen configuration and paired seeds where feasible; any seed exception is recorded
student_arms.inference_contract: S, H, and D consume only activation prefixes and retained student state; no candidate IDs, teacher scores, labels, source tokens, prefix calls, or feedback
student_arms.seed_pairing: each seed runs all affine/S/H/D arms with the same public rows, labels, order, and schedule

teacher_contract.candidate_id_rule: candidate identities are generated once from the same frozen public decoder/resource and reused byte-for-byte by H and D

evidence_positions.selection_source: correction_pool only; no fresh evaluation records

modes.native_anchor: native causal A1+A2 scorer with K=256, if authorized, uses only its declared reconstructed prefix and is reported separately
modes.privileged_training_teacher: known public prefix may be used to qualify K=32 teacher scores and create training evidence; report as privileged and do not call it native reconstruction

teacher_contract.native_anchor_role: evaluation-only native A1+A2 anchor; separate from privileged K=32 training evidence
required_diagnostics: candidate recall at each declared k
teacher fixes and teacher-introduced errors relative to public labels
score span and calibrated/normalized score distribution
teacher_contract.role: public training-only supervision; never an inference dependency
teacher_contract.scorer: frozen public A2-style selector with its exact method/config/asset hashes recorded
teacher_contract.truth_policy: public labels may be used for training-only qualification; no evaluation truth, target-prefix weights, or holdout answers enter teacher construction

truth_and_freeze.evaluation_truth_schema: JSONL rows {record_id, token_ids}; one file per target condition
truth_and_freeze.holdout: none planned for this exploratory comparison; any later holdout requires a new frozen request
truth_and_freeze.public_training_truth: public fit/replay, correction, and validation labels may be read before freeze
truth_and_freeze.truth_opening_gate: freeze source selection, observation index, all S/H/D weights, baseline weights, teacher evidence, candidate identities, and prediction roots before the evaluator scorer opens any evaluation truth
